name: Chongqing Machinery & Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: Chongqing Machinery & Electric Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, designs, manufactures, and sells clean energy equipment and high-end smart manufacturing equipment. It operates through nine segments: Engine, General Machinery, Wind Turbine Blade, Wire and Cable, Intelligent Manufacturing, CNC machine tools, High voltage transformer, Material Sales, Financial services, and Other segments. The company also produces and sells engine products, mechanical products, wind turbine blades, wire and cable, automation, intelligent equipment and accessories, cutting tool, screw and various complex parts, and machine tools.
